title: RNGdle - Daily Random Number Game
description: Play RNGdle online. Generate one daily number, collect mathematical and meme badges, and score EP from rare digit patterns.
twitterDescription: Generate today's RNGdle number and see which badges it unlocks.
schemaDescription: RNGdle is a browser game where each daily random number is analyzed for badges, rarity, and EP.

seoSections.title: What is RNGdle?
seoSections.subtitle: Unused
paragraphs: RNGdle is a daily random number game inspired by the thrill of one clean roll. Each day, the player generates a number from 0 to 1,000,000 and the game scans it for patterns such as primes, palindromes, repeated digits, lucky sevens, clean endings, and special number references.

The fun comes from turning pure randomness into a scorecard. A plain number can still earn common badges, while rare coincidences such as exact special numbers, long repeated runs, or unusual mathematical properties can produce huge EP swings.

seoSections.title: How does scoring work?
seoSections.subtitle: Unused
paragraphs: Every matched badge has an EP value. Common badges such as Even, Odd, Pair, or Six Digits add small amounts, while rare badges such as Jackpot, Leet, Exact Nice, or six repeated sevens are worth dramatically more.

Some badges belong to the same family. In those cases, only the strongest badge in that family contributes EP, while the rest still appear as supporting discoveries. This keeps one lucky pattern from double-counting too aggressively.

seoSections.title: Is this version daily?
seoSections.subtitle: Unused
paragraphs: Yes. This static version stores one roll per UTC day in the browser using localStorage. The next roll becomes available after the UTC midnight countdown reaches zero.
Because this is a static remake, the roll history, lifetime EP, and daily lock live on the current device. There are no accounts, server rankings, or shared backend data in this project.

seoSections.title: What is different from the live RNGdle site?
seoSections.subtitle: Unused
paragraphs: The core gameplay loop is reproduced: generate a daily number, reveal badges, calculate EP, estimate rarity, and share the result.

Live-site features that require a backend, such as authenticated profiles, global leaderboards, hearts, friend feeds, and server-issued claim tokens, are intentionally represented as local-only behavior here.
